question: Who launched the first edition of the nationwide 'Hack-AI-thon' to promote AI-based innovation in the insurance sector?
solution:
The correct answer is __**SBI Life Insurance.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **SBI Life Insurance launched the first edition of its nationwide 'Hack-AI-thon' initiative.**
 
• **The initiative aims to encourage tech students to address challenges in the insurance sector using artificial intelligence.**
 
• **The event witnessed participation from over 7,500 students, with 50 teams shortlisted for the finale in Mumbai.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **SBI Life Insurance__ launched the first-ever nationwide 'Hack-AI-thon' to promote AI solutions in the insurance domain.**
 
• The competition drew over 7,500 student participants from across India.
 
• Top 50 teams were selected to showcase their ideas in the grand finale in Mumbai.
 
• Focus areas included improving customer experience, fraud detection, and accessibility of insurance products.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

__
 
• SBI Life Insurance__

 __
 
• Established in 2001 as a joint venture between State Bank of India and BNP Paribas Cardif
 
• Headquartered in Mumbai
 
• Offers a range of life insurance and pension products
 
 
 
• Hack-AI-thon Objectives__
 __
 
• Leverage AI to enhance operational efficiency in insurance
 
• Encourage innovation among young tech talent
 
• Address sectoral challenges like fraud, accessibility, and personalization
 
 
 
• Grand Finale__
 
 
• To be held in Mumbai
 
• Top solutions will be evaluated by industry experts
 
• Winning teams may get opportunities for incubation or deployment
